purpose: Teach: 親御/チェス/ブラームス/目覚める/下山/泥沼/すっと/彷彿

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、孫の、絶対、親御、絶対、さん、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、よく、絶対、お話、絶対、してきたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young — do you remember? You and Grandpa used to talk so earnestly about everything.
lines.style: Quiet, reaching back in time. Soft opening, almost tentative. Warm nostalgia held close to the chest. Eyes focused on something distant and gentle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、チェス、絶対、楽しんだわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: I do, dear. When we were young, I remember enjoying chess with Grandpa so much. Really, truly.
lines.style: A small smile in the voice. Gentle affirmation. Speaking from deep in memory, not performing it. Warmth that doesn't need volume to be felt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ラジオで、絶対、ブラームス、絶対、よく、絶対、聞いたぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, remember how we'd listen to Brahms on the radio when we were young? We'd hear it so often.
lines.style: Tender vulnerability in the asking. Soft, deliberate pace. Each phrase is an offering, not a demand. The voice of someone wanting to hold the memory together.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、自然に、絶対、目覚める、絶対、ことが、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、できたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes — when we were young, your grandfather could wake up naturally in the morning, just like that. Don't you remember, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate certainty. A small, knowing laugh underneath. Speaking as if these memories are shared ground. Gentle correction wrapped in warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、山登り、絶対、下山、絶対、まで、絶対、二人で、絶対、楽しんだわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when we were young — those hikes with your father, all the way down the mountain. We enjoyed them so much, didn't we?
lines.style: Earnest, almost pleading. Slow, deliberate pacing. The voice searching for confirmation of something that mattered deeply. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、家業が、絶対、泥沼、絶対、状態だった時期、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: There was that time, dear, when your family business was caught in such difficult waters. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Gentle but steady. Not avoiding the hard thing. Speaking it plainly because it was real. The voice of someone who lived through it and came through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、すっと、絶対、立ち振る舞い、絶対、綺麗だったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When you were young, the way you carried yourself was so graceful. So beautiful.
lines.style: Soft wonder. The voice of someone seeing her across the years. Barely breathed out, almost reverent. No hesitation — just quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃の、絶対、ご両親、絶対、彷彿、絶対、と、絶対、させるわよ、あなた
lines.en: Grandpa, you remind me so much of your parents from when you were young. You really do, dear.
lines.style: Affectionate, almost teasing. Warm recognition. The voice turning the mirror back. Speaking with the ease of someone who knows him deeply.
